items.title: Message settings page shows notification sound picker
steps: Click the settings (gear) control in the Messages inbox header
Confirm page has icon-only chrome (back + settings icons) — no 'Message settings' h1 or subtitle
Confirm notification sounds section is visible with toggle, sound grid, and Save button
items.expected: Full sound picker UI lives on Message settings with icon header only; not on Account settings.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author.

items.title: Account settings no longer shows notification sounds
items.precondition: Signed in; own profile → Account settings (/settings)
items.expected: Only Privacy, Security, and More settings stubs remain. No notification sound picker. Page subtitle no longer mentions notification preferences.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author.

items.title: Sound preferences still persist and play after move
items.precondition: Two mutuals; sounds enabled; socket connected; user unlocked audio
steps: On /messages/settings, pick a sound and save
With peer on Feed, receive inbound DM — hear selected sound
Toggle sounds off on Message settings, save — inbound DM is silent
items.expected: localStorage keys unchanged; playback hook in AppShell still gates on same prefs.
items.waiver: Two-browser interactive verify deferred to PR author.

items.title: Back navigation from message settings
steps: Use back link or browser back
items.expected: Clear path back to inbox without losing signed-in state.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author.
